Text:
I drank a single can of the Switch Orange Tangerine flavor today. Upon first impression, the physical size of the can is a tiny -- 8oz or 250ml. This in contrast to a regular can of soda size which is 12 ounces or 355 ml. Therefore, only about 2/3 the content of a normal can of soda. To say the least, this isn't enough liquid for me in one sitting. I need more to drink than that to quench a tiny bit of thirst so I was quite disappointed without even opening the thing up.

The taste of the drink itself was satisfying. Since there is no added sugar (which is usually corn syrup in the US) the flavor was not too sweet nor was it too bland. However, it wasn't anything like drinking a fresh bottle of 100% natural juice. More on the side of mixed syrup with water.

What kills this product is the high price. Product right now comes out to about a buck a can. I would be angry paying that out of a vending machine for its small size but for purchasing in bulk, it is an insult to say the least. Not worth the money.
